Best to control weeds by physically removing them, smothering them, outcompete with desirables, or getting animals to eat them. Last resort herbicides safely in limited amounts. Don't salt.
Also, once gone, don't use fertiliser. That just brings more weeds, they thrive on the stuff. Use organic nutrients.
